messages:
Priya (Product): Quick live thread from today's all-hands sec Q&A. Customers asked for a concise statement on BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM support for Private, DSAR ownership, immutable audit copies, and ISO evidence timing. Can we capture answers here so I can share externally?
Leah (Head of Security): TL;DR bullets incoming.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK: supported for Dedicated & Private. We recommend a 90-day rotation cadence; we will not enforce forced rewraps of customer-managed keys. We offer an opt-in managed rotation add-on that produces rotation artifacts for audits.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSM support: on-prem HSMs via a KMIP connector agent. We'll run two pilot integrations (May/June); target GA end of Q3 pending pilot results and security sign-off. Connector requires HSM certs and network validation.
Sam (Privacy): DSAR ownership: Hosted (Redwood-managed): we retain request metadata by default; request/response payloads are not stored unless the customer opts in to logging. Private/Dedicated (customer-managed infra): customers are responsible for DSAR responses for customer data. Redwood will provide metadata export tooling and contract-bound assistance.
Anya (Compliance): ISO/SOC2 evidence roadmap (high level): June - export templates; August - self-serve evidence bundles; September - auditor-access controls. Dates are tentative; I'll publish a timeline doc.
Priya (Product): What about immutable (WORM) audit replicas and auditor access?
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can stream audit logs to customer-owned buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning. For WORM semantics customers should enable provider-side object locking / bucket immutability. We'll publish recipes and recommended IAM/bucket policies. Planned feature: read-only auditor access to evidence bundles (self-serve) — legal/contract guardrails needed.
Leah (Head of Security): Security caveat for HSMs: if keys never leave the HSM, some forensic traces live only in the HSM audit logs; customers must coordinate with their HSM operator for that evidence. We'll document this.
Legal-Bot: Reminder: auditor access feature requires NDA toggle and auditor terms. Maya (Legal) will draft language.
Priya (Product): Action items and owners?
Leah (Head of Security): I will publish BYOK FAQ + one-paragraph DSAR ownership policy (SEC-2021).
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll publish HSM connector pilot checklist + signup and the WORM recipes (SEC-2022).
Anya (Compliance): I'll publish ISO evidence timeline + sample exports (SEC-2023).
Sam (Privacy): I'll draft the customer-facing DSAR blurb and paste it here for review.
Priya (Product): Great — please drop internal doc links when available and I'll bundle into a customer FAQ. Thanks everyone.
Leah (Head of Security): Thanks all; closing the loop. For any detailed architecture under NDA route via Legal/SEs.
